data.notes: As of October 2026, September 2027 confirmations are mostly venue-promoted concerts; Paris club nights and late-summer festivals are not yet substantially announced.

events.title: Jok'Air
events.summary: Paris rapper Jok'Air headlines Plenitude Arena for the biggest concert of his career, following the album Pretty Girls Love Jok'Air and a major 2025 sold-out run.

events.title: Trinix
events.summary: French electronic duo Trinix plays two Olympia nights billed as their only French indoor dates of 2027, presenting a new live show after several years of international touring.

events.title: Agnes Obel
events.summary: Agnes Obel plays two Olympia dates around her album The Meaning of Flowers, bringing her chamber-pop sound with elements of alternative pop, jazz and electronic music.

events.title: Mari Froes
events.summary: Brazilian artist Mari Froes brings her international tour to Zénith Paris, with a set drawing on Brazilian popular music, new-album material, and earlier songs.

events.title: Ronan Keating - Just Getting Started World Tour
events.summary: Ronan Keating brings his Just Getting Started World Tour to Salle Pleyel, mixing solo material with Boyzone-era pop hits.

events.title: Zazie - Volatil Tour
events.summary: Zazie returns to the Paris stage at Zénith Paris - La Villette as part of her 2027 Volatil Tour.

events.title: Orange Blossom
events.summary: Orange Blossom closes the Spells from the Drunken Sirens tour at Le Trianon, blending electronic production with Turkish, Egyptian, Malian, Senegalese and Cuban influences.

events.title: Ycare - Resilience Tour
events.summary: Ycare opens a four-date Olympia residency with the Resilience Tour, centered on a rock-influenced Jacques Brel tribute project arranged with Pascal Obispo.

events.title: Marie Sarah
events.summary: Marie Sarah plays Le Trianon after sold-out 2026 full-band dates and support slots for artists including Zucchero and Nile Rodgers/Chic.

events.title: I Gotta Feeling – Saison 3
events.venueName: Le Dôme de Paris - Palais des Sports
events.summary: I Gotta Feeling – Saison 3 is confirmed for two 20:00 performances at Le Dôme de Paris on 24 and 25 September 2027, presented as a three-hour 2000s nostalgia concert show with era-defining hits.
